arrive.speaker: narrator
arrive.text: Wings the size of sails unfold from the smoke. A moth, vast and grey, every lantern of the city hanging from its legs on silk.

b1.speaker: lamplighter
b1.text: Another lamp come to be put out.

b2.speaker: lamplighter
b2.text: Do you know what I carry, samurai? The ones the fog would swallow. I walk them home. Your master has no home to walk to - so he wants all of ours.

choices.text: Then why didn't you stop him?

b_why.speaker: lamplighter
b_why.text: I am stopping him. With what's left of me.

b_fight.speaker: lamplighter
b_fight.text: Let me show you what a light looks like up close.
